description: This file implements the GstMappedBuffer class, which manages mapping and unmapping of GStreamer buffers, providing access to buffer data and size, and handling resource cleanup.

classes.name: GstMappedBuffer
classes.description: A class that manages the mapping state of a GStreamer buffer, providing access to its data and size, and ensuring proper unmapping when destroyed.

methods.name: GstMappedBuffer::GstMappedBuffer
methods.description: Constructor that maps a GStreamer buffer with specified flags.

methods.name: GstMappedBuffer::~GstMappedBuffer
methods.description: Destructor that unmaps the buffer if it is currently mapped.

methods.name: GstMappedBuffer::data
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the buffer data if mapped, otherwise nullptr.

methods.name: GstMappedBuffer::size
methods.description: Returns the size of the mapped buffer, or 0 if not mapped.

methods.name: GstMappedBuffer::operator bool
methods.description: Returns true if the buffer is currently mapped, false otherwise.
